versions.changelog:
- 移除 skill-card.md 文件。
- 更新 SKILL.md，进一步明确远程 root 密码输入流程及凭证安全处理细节。
- 新增关于密码输入顺序、风险确认、密码处理原则与重置提醒的安全要求。
- 补充建议优先通过临时密码、Secret Store 等安全方案输入 root 密码，禁止直接日志回显、参数明文或落盘。
- 其他原有功能和流程不变，整体安全边界更为严格。

Version 1.0.4 — Major update: Security framework overhaul, adopts MCP architecture, and reworks deployment/installation.

- Replaces previous complex server scripts/utilities with a single Python orchestrator and comprehensive operations security guidelines.
- Adds references, licensing, and official packaged skills (Go/Python/Node/Java/HTML deploy, troubleshooting, reverse proxy, etc.) under assets/.
- Removes server-side code, per-feature scripts (monitoring, logs, SSH, sites, crontab, etc.), and direct shell orchestration.
- Enforces stricter credential and TLS/CA handling: no disabling TLS verification or installing untrusted certificates; all sensitive values are protected.
- Introduces clearer, safer deployment/upgrade process using only Skill-bundled, hash-verified helpers; plain HTTP only allowed for loopback.
- MCP integration instructions for modern AI Agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor, WorkBuddy); specific safe Skill installation workflow.
- New documentation focused on security boundaries, delegated operations, and explicit user confirmation before any risky changes.

Initial release of the 宝塔面板 (btpanel) Skill.

- Enables AI Agent integration with 宝塔面板 for website, file, database, Docker, scheduled tasks, and server environment management.
- Supports automated installation and secure configuration of 宝塔面板 and MCP services, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and WorkBuddy integration.
- Implements strict security boundaries: prioritizes read-only queries by default, requires user confirmation before high-impact changes, and never exposes secrets like passwords or tokens.
- Includes robust safety checks for installation, certificate verification, and only allows secure, validated downloads and connections.
- Provides detailed procedures and user confirmations for deployment, configuration, and error handling.
- Allows selective installation of bundled companion Skills with clear user prompts and safe copy operations.

btpanel v1.0.3

- 增加了关于 SSL 证书类型（受信任/自签名）的配置说明，并对添加服务器时如何处理自签名证书进行了详细指引
- 配置指引中加入 `--verify-ssl false` 场景补充，提升非受信任证书下的易用性
- 优化矩阵说明，明确技能依赖关系描述
- 清理开头报告生成示例中的冗余图片代码
- 其他文档结构优化，增强了初次配置服务器的用户引导与流程说明

btpanel v1.0.2

- 新增 bt_common/files_client.py 文件，为文件管理相关功能提供客户端支持
- 新增 scripts/check_env.py 脚本，用于检查技能包及依赖环境
- SKILL.md 文档补充「技能依赖关系」说明，列明 btpanel、btpanel_files、btpanel_phpsite 的协作与依赖要点
处理部分情况下面板地址解析异常问题

btpanel 1.0.0 初始版本发布。

- 提供宝塔面板(BT-Panel)服务器的全方位运维监控能力：支持多服务器管理、系统资源监控、网站和服务状态检查、SSH安全审计、计划任务管理、日志读取等功能。
- 支持关键任务如SSL证书到期检测、服务故障排查和备份任务检查等常用运维场景。
- 提供详细的命令行用法，并给出常见运维需求的操作说明和参数说明。
- 强调数据中立和隐私保护，使用前执行步骤会向用户说明。
